Local False Discovery Rates

This is another of the old style R packages, not even using roxygen!

Tasks

  1. First create some tests so that we ensure no regressions
  2. Next roxygenize the package so that it is a bit modern, make that version 1.1-9.
  3. Ensure no revdep breakages
  4. Create a dev branch from 1.1-9 and then convert to a tidymodel friendly framework
  5. Add new tests as needed
  6. Ensure backward compatibility so that no revdep packages break.
